scope: offline contract tests for the modular game-account administration feature and its background jobs
scenario: team-scoped user picker and push-route management
JSONL account import and import history
single, all and import-scoped account checks
credential redaction from render data and verifier summaries
queued import and batch-check progress, cancellation and terminal history
stale DialogRef detaches UI delivery without losing the job result
checks: explicit enabled administrator is required before dialog start
the final enabled administrator cannot be disabled or demoted
the team user picker excludes bots and already assigned application users
submitted user IDs are revalidated against the configured team and usernames come from Mattermost
import stores accepted accounts and aggregate issues without raw source rows
password and cookie values are absent from account render data and repr
account card shows only password presence, cookie count and unique domains
checker summaries are redacted before persistence and rendering
a stale checker result cannot overwrite changed credentials
push subscriptions receive only their selected events
declared dashboard and account action rows preserve their expected shapes
job revisions are monotonic and terminal snapshots are immutable
an outdated dialog post does not abort the business operation
live_checks: owned bot was added to the fixture team and UI scenarios channel
the resulting bot post contained native mm_blocks actions
limitations: MemoryAdminRepository is non-durable and intended only for tests or local demos
production file reading, account verification and push delivery require injected adapters
production must implement GameAdminJobRepository and GameAdminJobQueue with durable infrastructure
the local memory queue and worker are process-local and lose jobs on restart
exact button rows require a proven Blocks client profile
account import requires a proven forms.file capability
the new team-scoped picker and GetUsers read have offline HTTP coverage but were not rerun on the live stand
the background job progress window was not rerun on the live stand after worker integration
